name: fulfilllens-cn
description: FulfillLens CN 本地优先履约分析工具

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,api --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && npx --yes wrangler@4.120.0 deploy
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api && npm run lint:cloudflare
scripts.lint:api: python -m ruff check apps/api tests scripts
scripts.format: npm run format:web && npm run format:cloudflare && npm run format:api && npm run format:docs
scripts.format:api: python -m ruff check --select I --fix apps/api tests scripts && python -m ruff format apps/api tests scripts
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:web && npm run format:check:cloudflare && npm run format:check:api && npm run format:check:docs
scripts.format:check:api: python -m ruff format --check apps/api tests scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:cloudflare && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:cloudflare && npm run test:api
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run audit && npm run docs:check && npm run licenses:check
